message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through a kitchen drawer, looking for my favorite measuring cup, when I stumbled upon my old go-bag. It was stuffed with things I thought I’d need in case of an emergency—some snacks, a flashlight, and an expired coupon for a pizza place. I chuckled at the thought of being ‘prepared’ with last year’s pizza deal. 

That little moment reminded me how easy it is to think we’re ready, but sometimes, we’re just a bit off the mark. 

So, I took a few minutes to refresh my go-bag—not just with food, but with a little bit of humor, too. It’s nice to have a plan, but it’s even nicer when we can laugh at our little mishaps along the way. Have you checked your go-bag lately?
